Luxury Sprinter van rentals in Scottsdale run from $145 to $295 per hour with us, chauffeur included, with a 4-hour minimum. Which Sprinter fits your group

Executive Black Sprinter and Executive White Sprinter — the workhorses. Forward-facing leather captain's chairs, USB power, tinted windows, and room for 14 with luggage space behind the last row. These cover airport groups, corporate transportation, golf mornings, and Sedona day trips. The white one is the default for wedding parties.

Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax and 16 Pax) — the celebration van. Perimeter lounge seating, LED lighting, premium sound, coolers, and a ceiling you can stand under. This is the modern answer to the classic limousine, and it is what most prom, birthday, and bachelorette groups book. Drinks are BYOB for 21-and-over groups.

Maybach Shuttle Sprinter — the quiet VIP van. Eight seats, a private cabin feel, and a rate that sits between the executive vans and the Maybach Jet. It suits executive teams, families who want space, and small wedding parties.

Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter — the top party van. Fifteen seats with the full lounge build. If the night out is the point — Old Town, a concert, a milestone birthday — this is the one. See Scottsdale nightlife transportation.

Maybach Jet Sprinter — the flagship. Nine seats in a jet-style cabin: the best interior in the fleet, booked for executive travel, couples' celebrations, and anyone who wants the top seat in Scottsdale.

What a rental costs in practice

Corporate shuttle, 4 hours. An Executive Black Sprinter moving a team of 14 between a Scottsdale Airpark office and a dinner venue: 4 hours at $145 is $580, or about $626 with tax — roughly $45 per person.

Wedding day, 8 hours. An Executive White Sprinter on the party all day: 8 hours earns 1 free hour, so 7 bill at $145, or $1,015, about $1,096 with tax. Add a second Sprinter for the family side and the day is fully covered.

Night out, 5 hours. Fifteen riders in the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter: 5 hours at $250 is $1,250, or $1,350 with tax — $90 per person, door-to-door, with nobody split across rideshares.

Sedona day trip, 10 hours. An Executive Sprinter up to the red rocks and back: 10 hours earns 1 free hour, so 9 bill at $145, or $1,305, about $1,409 with tax for the group. The Sedona red rocks day trip page covers the route.

Chauffeured rental vs. driving yourself

Self-drive van rentals exist, but they solve a different problem. A chauffeured Sprinter means no one in your group watches the road instead of the desert, no one skips the wine tasting, no one argues about who drives home from Old Town, and parking, loading zones, and venue drop-offs are handled. For most celebrations and corporate outings, the chauffeur is the point.

Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to rent a luxury Sprinter van in Scottsdale?
Between $145 and $295 per hour with a chauffeur, depending on the model, with a 4-hour minimum. A typical 4-hour booking runs $580 to $1,180 before tax.

Can we rent a Sprinter without a driver?
No. Every rental is chauffeured. That is what keeps the vehicles in top condition and your group free to enjoy the day.

How many people fit in a Sprinter van?
Our Sprinters seat 8 to 16 depending on the model. Groups of 20 or more move to a party bus or run two Sprinters together.

What is the difference between the limo Sprinter and the party Sprinter?
Layout and energy. The Limo Party Sprinters (13 and 16 seats) are the classic celebration lounge; the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter (15 seats) is the top build with the biggest sound and lighting. The executive models are forward-facing and quieter.
